name: agent-comms
description: A band above the prompt listing every message to another agent still waiting on a reply, with a running clock and a toast when the reply lands. Tracks subagents and SendMessage; add MCP tools that ask other agents with the agentTools option.

agentTools.title: Agent tools
agentTools.description: MCP tools that hand a question to another agent, as tool=Label pairs separated by semicolons. Subagents and SendMessage are always tracked.
